correctness.rationale: At every parameter t, the increment distance is D_p(h)=Σ_{n≥0}2^{-np}|e^{i2^nh}-1|^p, independent of t. For J=floor(log2(1/|h|)), each n≤J contributes |h|^p[1+O_p((2^nh)^2)], with total Taylor error O(|h|^p); the geometric tail n>J is O(|h|^p). Hence D_p(h)=|h|^p(log(1/|h|)/ln2+O_p(1)). g_p(D_p(h))/|h| tends uniformly to c=(p ln2)^(-1/p). For all sufficiently small d_p-diameter cover sets, first-coordinate injectivity and pairwise circle-arc separation compare g_p diameter to c times shortest enclosing arc length; lower and upper arc-cover arguments give total length exactly 2πc, regular variation gives dim 1/p and N(ε)~2π[(ln(1/ε))/(p ln2 ε)]^(1/p). Every coordinate derivative is i exp(i2^nt), non-ell_p, forbidding a vector derivative. Verified normalization d_p=||.||_p^p (a metric) versus nonmetric quasi-norm.
